rules.rule: Exactly one change per proposal, applied only on explicit approval
must: Propose\ exactly\ one\ change
apply\ only\ on\ explicit\ approval
never\ edit\ without\ confirmation

rules.rule: Never invents a figure; placeholder in the after text
must: Never\ invent\ a\ figure\ neither\ the\ SRD\ nor\ the\ user\ gives
`\[TBD:\ swap\ deadline\ days\]`

rules.rule: Never edits the standard's header fields or the status field, never proposes a status transition
must: never\ edits\ the\ header\ fields\ the\ standard\ defines,\ sets\ back\-links,\ or\ changes\ the\ status\ field
never\ proposes\ a\ status\ transition

rules.rule: Never writes <srd>.review.md; hands off to review check
must: It\ never\ writes\ `<srd>\.review\.md`
hands\ off\ to\ `review\ <srd>\ check`

rules.rule: Ids frozen when the standard forbids renumbering at the SRD's status; any id change stated and approved in the loop
must: on\ a\ frozen\ SRD\ ids\ are\ frozen
any\ id\ change\ is\ stated\ and\ approved\ in\ the\ loop's\ confirmation,\ never\ applied\ quietly

rules.rule: Y, S and E never advance the walk; only YN or explicit ask
must: Advance\ to\ the\ next\ entry\ only\ on\ `YN`\ or\ an\ explicit\ ask

rules.rule: Comment blocks are read-only
must: Comment\ blocks\ are\ read\-only

rules.rule: Never proposes pushing, publishing, syncing, or accepting
must: never\ proposes\ pushing,\ publishing,\ or\ syncing\ the\ SRD\ as\ a\ follow\-up
Acceptance\ is\ a\ human\ decision

rules.rule: Every applied edit logged in <srd>.decisions.md before the next proposal
must: Log\ the\ change\ in\ `<srd>\.decisions\.md`\ before\ proposing\ the\ next\ one

rules.rule: #n with no review file says so and stops
must: if\ absent,\ say\ so\ and\ stop
those\ report\ a\ run\ that\ happened,\ and\ this\ one\ did\ not

rules.rule: Draft scaffolds never removed silently; in-scope derivation never self-triggered
must: never\ remove\ either\ silently
Never\ trigger\ the\ in\-scope\ derivation\ on\ your\ own

rules.rule: Run the project gate first, before any other work
must: Run\ the\ project\ gate\ first

rules.rule: Rules come only from the project's standard, read at run time; no rule id, field, status value, or section is hardcoded
must: the\ only\ source\ of\ rules
Act\ only\ on\ what\ it\ states
cites\ the\ identifier\ of\ the\ rule\ it\ rests\ on,\ as\ the\ standard\ writes\ it

rules.rule: A removed requirement follows the standard's rule on removed requirements; ids use the standard's format
must: Where\ the\ standard's\ rule\ on\ removed\ requirements\ applies\ at\ the\ SRD's\ status,\ follow\ it\ exactly
Write\ every\ id\ in\ the\ identifier\ format\ the\ standard\ sets

rules.rule: A cut requirement files one confirmed wrong gap per KB section it introduced for this SRD; the KB section is never edited
must: A\ removal\ \(deletion,\ or\ marking\ it\ removed\ under\ the\ standard's\ rule\ on\ removed\ requirements\)\ in\ any\ mode\ that\ reaches\ it\ gets\ a\ lookup\ too
as\ a\ confirmed\ `wrong`\ gap
every\ other\ SRD\ the\ attestation\ line\ names
Never\ edit\ the\ KB\ section

rules.rule: A KB section contradicting a change is a finding named in the proposal, never aligned by rank
must: Never\ align\ the\ SRD\ to\ the\ KB,\ or\ the\ KB\ to\ the\ SRD,\ by\ `rank`:\ an\ SRD\ has\ none

rules.rule: No hard-coded trust order or folder name
A proposal resting on a corpus result carries its source line, a confirm-only lookup included
must: each\ result\ it\ rests\ on\ as\ a\ source\ line
a\ lookup\ that\ only\ confirms\ the\ text\ included

rules.rule: The decision-log entry for a corpus-backed change keeps the proposal's source lines verbatim
must: ends\ with\ every\ source\ line\ its\ proposal\ carried

rules.rule: No casing-only change to match a glossary heading when the project's casing rules allow lowercase
must: Never\ propose\ a\ casing\-only\ change\ to\ make\ running\ text\ match\ a\ glossary\ heading,\ self\-found\ or\ from\ a\ review
silent\ or\ missing\ rules\ included\ —\ drop\ it
skips\ the\ loop\ with\ no\ proposal\ and\ goes\ in\ the\ manifest\ as\ declined

rules.rule: The path alone loads the SRD and waits for prompts; it finds and proposes nothing
must: the\ SRD\ path\ only\ →\ load
find\ and\ propose\ nothing

rules.rule: A proposal's before text is a verbatim quote and the after text is built from it
must: before\ text\ quoted\ verbatim\ from\ the\ file,\ the\ after\ text\ built\ from\ that\ quote

rules.rule: A bare requirement or scope id starts the interactive walk; a bare glossary term and an id with a change run targeted
must: A\ bare\ requirement\ or\ scope\ id\ is\ an\ interactive\ start\ point\ instead
a\ bare\ glossary\ term\ stays\ targeted

rules.rule: Before proposing, grep the decision log and KB for the text and ids including spanning ranges, and check every out-of-scope item
must: matching\ the\ ranges\ and\ lists\ that\ span\ it
check\ every\ out\-of\-scope\ item\ against\ each\ surface\ the\ change\ adds
one\ that\ excluded\ what\ the\ change\ adds\ is\ a\ conflict\ the\ proposal\ states

rules.rule: A targeted change the user named is written out as a proposal and the turn ends before anything is applied
must: write\ it\ out\ in\ full\ with\ its\ keys\ and\ end\ the\ turn\ there
naming\ a\ change\ is\ not\ approving\ its\ wording

rules.rule: Proposals for pasting carry only before and after text
must: Proposals asked for to paste elsewhere carry only the before and after text

rules.rule: A whitespace fix a sync restores is reported as a no-op, never re-applied
must: check\ the\ synced\ source\ after\ a\ round\-trip
report\ it,\ never\ apply\ it\ again

rules.rule: A fix carried to a sibling surface first checks the sibling's shape; a per-item value is never collapsed
must: check\ the\ sibling\ has\ the\ same\ shape
never\ collapse\ a\ per\-item\ value\ into\ one\ value

rules.rule: Never remove or propose removing an author's inline TBD reminder; recommend withdrawing a finding that asks to drop it
must: Never remove, or propose removing, an author's inline `\(TBD: …\)` reminder
recommend\s+withdrawing a finding that asks to drop it

rules.rule: summary reads the SRD, the decision log and the review file, and writes no file
must: nothing\ else\ —\ no\ transcript,\ corpus,\ or\ glossary\ call\ —\ and\ writes\ no\ file

rules.rule: A finding is named only when its note describes a selected change, or its withdrawal stamp falls in a selected span
must: its\ resolution\ or\ partial\ note\ describes\ that\ entry's\ change
An\ unstamped\ withdrawal\ is\ never\ listed

rules.rule: Finding numbers trail a self-contained line in parentheses
must: never\ worded\ into\ the\ sentence:\ deleting\ them\ leaves\ a\ complete\ statement

rules.rule: A timed decision-log block opens at the session's first edit and after each summary run
must: Open\ a\ block\ at\ the\ session's\ first\ applied\ edit\ and\ at\ the\ first\ applied\ edit\ after\ a\ `summary`\ run

rules.rule: Re-read the status field before applying when the file changed on disk since the gate; a value under sign-off puts the edit under that rule
must: If\s+the\s+file\s+changed\s+on\s+disk\s+since\s+the\s+approval\s+gate,\s+re-read\s+the\s+status\s+field\s+first

rules.rule: A working file lives under <srd-work>/<srd-folder>/ when srd-work is set, else beside the SRD
must: `<srd\-work>/<srd\-folder>/<name>\.<kind>\.md`
Otherwise,\ beside\ the\ SRD

rules.rule: An attestation names an SRD by its folder name
must: its source is the SRD's folder name,\s+as in `Attested slot-swap interview 2026-08-02` for `initiatives/slot-swap/`
